title: NVIDIA Highlights Sharon AI as an Early Partner in New AI Infrastructure Initiative
summary: We're proud to share that NVIDIA has featured Sharon AI in its latest announcement introducing a new business model designed to expand access to AI
body_text: We’re proud to share that NVIDIA has featured Sharon AI in its latest announcement introducing a new business model designed to expand access to AI infrastructure at scale. In the announcement, NVIDIA outlines a new approach to supporting the next generation of AI factories, helping AI cloud providers deliver accelerated computing to startups, enterprises, model builders and research organizations through a revenue-sharing and credit-support model. As part of the announcement, NVIDIA identified Sharon AI as one of the first companies working with NVIDIA under this new initiative. The post also highlights Sharon AI’s planned deployment of up to 40,000 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GB300 GPUs, supporting our mission to build sovereign, large-scale AI compute infrastructure capable of serving the growing demands of AI training and inference. As our CEO and Co-Founder, James Manning, said in the announcement: “This strategic collaboration with NVIDIA marks a pivotal moment in Sharon AI’s mission to deliver sovereign, large-scale AI compute infrastructure.” The rapid adoption of AI is driving unprecedented demand for scalable, high-performance compute. We’re excited to be working alongside NVIDIA as this next generation of AI infrastructure is deployed, helping provide customers with access to world-class accelerated computing that can support the most demanding AI workloads. We’re honoured to be recognised by NVIDIA as an early participant in this initiative and look forward to continuing to build the infrastructure that will power the next wave of AI innovation. We encourage customers, partners and the broader AI community to read NVIDIA’s announcement and follow our journey as we continue expanding Sharon AI’s AI factory capabilities. Read the full article here: https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia-unlocks-ai-compute-at-scale-capital-partners-to-power-ai-infrastructure-buildout/ Contacts Sharon AI Media Enquiries: Ross Barrows – Head of Capital Strategy & Investor Relations Ross.barrows@sharonai.com Zachary Nevas IMS Investor Relations +1 203.972.9200 sharonai@imsinvestorrelations.com

title: Gladstone Investment Corporation Acquires DHE Computer Systems, LLC
body_text: Gladstone Investment Corporation Acquires DHE Computer Systems, LLC Download as PDF July 10, 2026 8:30am EDT MCLEAN, VA / ACCESS Newswire / July 10, 2026 / Gladstone Investment Corporation (NASDAQ:GAIN) ("Gladstone Investment") is pleased to announce its acquisition of DHE Computer Systems, LLC ("DHE"). Gladstone Investment provided debt and equity financing to complete the transaction. DHE (the "Company"), headquartered in Centennial, Colorado, is a leading full-service technology solutions provider serving the state, local, and education and commercial markets. DHE provides end-to-end IT products and lifecycle services, including hardware, software, device configuration and enrollment, deployment logistics, repair and warranty support, data recovery, and emerging managed services. DHE's existing management team, led by Chief Executive Officer Dan Hammack, will continue to lead the business following the transaction. The Company's founders, Dan Hammack and Elena "Annie" Hammack, will remain meaningful shareholders alongside Gladstone Investment. "We are excited to partner with Dan, Annie and the entire DHE team as the Company continues its next phase of growth," said Michael Cueter, Managing Director at Gladstone Investment. "DHE has established itself as a trusted, high-touch technology partner to schools, government agencies and commercial customers by delivering the products, services and support needed to manage complex device fleets and broader IT service solutions. We believe DHE's strong customer relationships, OEM partnerships, service capabilities and expanding technology offerings create a compelling platform for continued growth." "The Hammack family is excited to partner with Gladstone Investment as we begin DHE's next chapter," said Dan Hammack. "Since founding DHE, our focus has always been on serving as a trusted technology partner to our customers and helping them solve complex IT needs with responsive service and practical solutions. We believe Gladstone Investment is the right partner to help us build on that foundation, continue investing in our team and expanding capabilities, and pursue the next phase of growth for the business." "DHE represents another strong example of Gladstone Investment's strategy of partnering with successful founder- and management-owned lower middle market businesses," said David Dullum, Chief Executive Officer and President of Gladstone Investment. "This investment represents our dedication to our ultimate goal of investing in quality companies that will produce stable income for dividends to Gladstone Investment's shareholders, as well as longer-term capital appreciation resulting in capital gains." Gladstone Investment is a publicly traded business development company that seeks to make equity and secured debt investments in lower middle market businesses in connection with acquisitions, changes in control, and recapitalizations. Additional information on the transaction can be found at www.gladstoneinvestment.com . For Investor Relations inquiries related to any of the monthly dividend paying Gladstone funds, please visit www.gladstone.com . Forward-looking Statements: The statements in this press release regarding the longer-term prospects of Gladstone Investment and DHE and its management team, and the ability of Gladstone Investment and DHE to grow and expand are "forward-looking statements." These forward-looking statements inherently involve certain risks and uncertainties in predicting future results and conditions. Although these statements are based on Gladstone Investment's current plans that are believed to be reasonable as of the date of this press release, a number of factors could cause actual results and conditions to differ materially from these forward-looking statements, including those factors described from time to time in Gladstone Investment's filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission. body_text: BackerKit is back for another Gen Con! We can’t wait to dive into four days of tabletop gaming with the crowdfunding community. Find us in Indianapolis July 30 – August 2 , at Booth #363 in the exhibit hall. We’ll have demos, playtests, panels, and the return of our fan-favorite Crowdfunding Side Quest activity. See you there. We can’t wait to connect in person again. We’ve got a great spot in the Exhibit Hall this year at Booth #363, and we’d love to see you there in person. There’s no better way to strategize and collaborate on your crowdfunding plans than face to face, so stop by, say hi, and tell us what you’re working on. Be sure to mark us on your map so you don’t miss us! At our booth you can expect to: Participate in Playtests & Demos: throughout the con we’ll be hosting live playtests and demos right at our booth featuring: As_Intended Games, Casper Haunts, Chaosium, Gifts Galore Games, Late Fee Studios, Louie’s Loops, My Mini Factory, Roll for Combat, Sunrise Tornado, Tavern Crawl Games, Twogether Studios, and Unphazed Games! Follow us on Instagram , Bluesky , and Twitter for up-to-date demo schedules and alerts! Participate in our annual BackerKit Crowdfunding Side Quest. Complete the quest this year and you’ll be rewarded with the newest enamel pin to add to your BackerKit train collection. Huge thank you to Karen Alleluia for the amazing new art! Talk shop with the BackerKit team. Whether you’re planning to launch a crowdfunding project soon or it’s still a ways off, stop by our booth and let’s talk through it together. We’ll have experts on hand throughout the entire convention to help set you up for crowdfunding success. Catch us as a guest panelist on Panda Game Manufacturing’s panel, Launching your Board Game: Insights into Crowdfunding, Manufacturing, and Fulfillment . RSVP now as space is limited! Ever wondered what it takes to get your idea funded, manufactured, and into the hands of board gamers? Join experts in crowdfunding (BackerKit), manufacturing (Panda Game Manufacturing), and fulfillment (Quartermaster Logistics) for tips and tricks on navigating the process successfully. We’ll wrap with a Q&A so attendees can ask specific questions about their own board game projects. And of course, swing by the BackerKit booth #363 while you’re at Gen Con. We can’t wait to see you all in Indianapolis soon! The post BackerKit at Gen Con 2026 appeared first on Crowdfunding Blog & Resources | BackerKit .

title: Holley Performance Brands Announces Sale of Scott Drake and Brothers Trucks Brands to CJ Pony Parts
summary: Holley Advances Portfolio Optimization Strategy, Sharpening Focus on Core Performance Verticals Through Sale of Select Restoration-Focused Brands NASHVILLE, Tenn., July 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Holley Performance Brands (“Holley”) (NYSE: HLLY), home to a portfolio of iconic automotive brands
body_text: Holley Performance Brands Announces Sale of Scott Drake and Brothers Trucks Brands to CJ Pony Parts July 28, 2026 PDF Version Holley Advances Portfolio Optimization Strategy, Sharpening Focus on Core Performance Verticals Through Sale of Select Restoration-Focused Brands NASHVILLE, Tenn., July 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Holley Performance Brands (“Holley”) (NYSE: HLLY), home to a portfolio of iconic automotive brands serving enthusiasts across the high-performance aftermarket, and CJ Pony Parts ("CJ Pony Parts" or the "Company"), a portfolio company of Century Park Capital Partners ("Century Park"), announced today that CJ Pony Parts has acquired select restoration-focused brands from Holley, including Scott Drake and Brothers Trucks. "This transaction reflects our continued focus on building a more focused Holley," said Matthew Stevenson, President and CEO of Holley Performance Brands. "Scott Drake and Brothers Trucks are strong brands with loyal enthusiast followings, and we believe that CJ Pony Parts is exceptionally well positioned to support their customers, partners, and long-term growth. For Holley, this divestiture allows us to reduce complexity and concentrate our resources on the core performance verticals that define our strategy and that we believe drive the greatest value for our customers and shareholders." "CJ Pony Parts has a proven playbook for taking great brands and reaching enthusiasts directly, and we saw the results firsthand with American Powertrain, which was acquired in 2024," said Adam Zacuto, Principal at Century Park. "Scott Drake and Brothers fit that model perfectly. By plugging them into CJ Pony Parts' marketing engine, fulfillment network, and customer service organization, we believe there is meaningful runway to grow both the direct-to-consumer and wholesale channels." "We are thrilled to bring Scott Drake and Brothers Trucks into the CJ Pony Parts family," said Mike Large, President and CEO of CJ Pony Parts. "These are brands our customers know and respect, and many of our own people helped build them. Our priority is to expand inventory depth, support our wholesale partners, and give Mustang and classic truck enthusiasts the expertise and service they expect from CJ Pony Parts." "Scott Drake and Brothers Trucks are exceptional brands with real equity among enthusiasts, and we have known and admired them for a long time," said Guy Zaczepinski, Managing Partner of Century Park and Chairman of CJ Pony Parts. "CJ Pony Parts has the team, e-commerce capabilities, and category expertise to support these brands and serve their customers. We could not be more excited to welcome them to the family." Holley and CJ Pony Parts will work closely together throughout the transition to help ensure a seamless customer experience. Both teams are committed to maintaining uninterrupted service, meeting customer demand, and working to ensure there are no disruptions to product availability or order fulfillment. For more Holley company news, click here . Forward-Looking Statements Certain statements in this press release may be considered “forward-looking statements” within the meaning of the “safe harbor” provisions of the United States Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. Such forward-looking statements are subject to risks, uncertainties, and other important factors which could cause actual results to differ materially from those expressed or implied by such forward-looking statements, including but not limited to Holley’s ability to execute or fully realize the expected benefits associated with its Portfolio Optimization Strategy, execute on its strategic growth objectives and the other risks and uncertainties set forth in the Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025 filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”) on March 16, 2026, and in any subsequent filings with the SEC. About Holley Performance Brands Holley Performance Brands (NYSE: HLLY) is home to a portfolio of iconic brands that serve enthusiasts across the high-performance aftermarket. The company designs, engineers, manufactures and markets category-leading products and solutions for automotive enthusiasts through a focused portfolio spanning four consumer vertical groupings: American Performance, Modern Truck & Off-Road, Euro & Import, and Safety & Racing. For more than a century, Holley has built its reputation through innovation, technical expertise and a deep understanding of enthusiast culture. For more information, visit holley.com. About CJ Pony Parts, LLC Founded in 1985, CJ Pony Parts is an e-commerce platform that sells restoration and performance parts to auto enthusiasts around the world. The Company is a premier provider in the classic Mustang aftermarket, with a broad product assortment of over 100K SKUs. In addition, CJ Pony Parts has developed an industry-leading library of online educational content for its customers. The Company's market-leading YouTube channel serves as a "go-to resource" for classic Mustang product instruction and installation trainings, and currently has over 200K subscribers. In addition to serving the classic Mustang community, CJ Pony Parts also offers a growing assortment of parts for late model Mustangs and classic trucks. The Company is headquartered in Harrisburg, PA with an additional warehouse facility in Las Vegas, NV. For more information on CJ Pony Parts, please visit www.cjponyparts.com . About Century Park Capital Partners Century Park Capital Partners is a Los Angeles-based private equity group established in 2000 that invests in family businesses, owner-operated firms and corporate divestitures with the purpose of accelerating growth and transforming these companies into leading industry players. We specialize in acquiring strategically well-positioned yet under-resourced middle market companies with identifiable potential for value creation. We leverage our C-level executive partners ("Century Leaders") in targeted sectors to build an investment thesis, evaluate opportunities, and lead portfolio companies through the value creation process. We further support our investments with proven operational and best practice initiatives, led by our operating team, including buy-and-build acquisition integration programs and infrastructure additions. For more information on Century Park, please visit www.centuryparkcapital.com . title: IEEE Kenya and Oracle Academy Collaborate to Empower the Next Generation of Engineers and Tech Innovators in Kenya
summary: Program helps future leaders gain the experience needed to launch careers and address skills gap with a focus on project management using Oracle Primavera
body_text: Oracle announced today that the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) Kenya will offer Oracle Academy project management curriculum and Oracle technologies across Kenya. This collaboration with Oracle Academy aims to equip IEEE Kenya students with the skills, resources, and certifications needed to excel in project management, with a special emphasis on Oracle Primavera, an industry-leading project management software used in construction and engineering. Oracle Academy will provide access to its comprehensive educational resources, including the Oracle Academy Primavera Project Management curriculum, which is designed to help students and professionals master project management principles and tools used widely across the global industry. "This collaboration with Oracle opens up new opportunities for IEEE students in Kenya to access top-tier computer science and project management education,” said Tom Coughlin, IEEE President & CEO. “IEEE Kenya has done an excellent job in pioneering this collaboration with Oracle. By incorporating Oracle Primavera, we are giving future project managers and engineers the skills they need to thrive in key sectors such as construction and engineering.” Oracle’s Primavera P6 Enterprise Project Portfolio Management will play a pivotal role in educating students to manage complex projects efficiently, from planning to execution. This software is widely used in fields such as engineering, construction, and manufacturing. Through hands-on curriculum and workshops, students will gain practical experience with Oracle Primavera for real-world project management, preparing them for key roles in the workforce. "This timely collaboration bridges the gap between students and industry technology, bringing real-world tools into the classroom,” said David Bunei, Oracle Kenya Country Director. “By connecting education with industry needs, we are equipping the next generation to lead and thrive in technology fields. We are excited to partner with IEEE Kenya to bring Oracle Primavera and other Oracle cutting-edge technologies such as Oracle Cloud and Oracle APEX to their student congress. This collaboration will provide the learners with practical skills, critical in today's industries.” In addition to Oracle Primavera, the collaboration will help educators teach in other key areas such as cloud computing, database management, Java programming, and data science. Students will also have the opportunity to earn globally recognized Oracle certifications, including those in cloud computing, significantly enhancing their employability. This collaboration highlights Oracle Academy’s commitment to supporting technology education. In addition, it demonstrates IEEE Kenya as a key player in advancing professional skills development in Kenya’s growing economy.

title: We Built an AI That Reads Blueprints Like an Estimator. Meet H1.
summary: Handoff H1 is the first purpose-built AI system for construction blueprint takeoffs — outperforming every major AI model by 30+ points and matching experienced estimators.
body_text: It is 4:30 in the morning. Most of the country is asleep. But one of our customers — a contractor running his own shop — is already at his desk, working through a takeoff before his crew shows up. He is not doing this because he loves takeoffs. Nobody does. He is doing it because a job came in, the blueprint needs to be read, the materials need to be counted, the numbers need to be right and there is no one else to do it. This is the hidden tax on every contractor who bids residential work. Before you can price a job, you have to earn it with 8 to 20 hours of careful, methodical work. Comb every sheet. Tally materials trade by trade. Cross-check the numbers. Then start again on the next one in the queue. Today, we are changing that. Introducing Handoff H1 H1 is Handoff's purpose-built AI System for construction blueprint takeoffs. Upload a blueprint PDF. Come back to a finished takeoff. Not a calculator. Not a template. A system that reads drawings, identifies trades, understands scale, interprets the conventions that never get written down and produces a complete material quantity list, automatically. H1 deploys specialized agents to inspect each trade, all trained the way an experienced estimator sees and interprets construction drawings. It handles the kind of cross-referencing that trips up general AI: connecting a floor-plan dimension on sheet A2 to a wall assembly detail on sheet A8, accounting for the standard waste factor every framer knows but no spec sheet ever lists, reading a window schedule the same way a seasoned estimator would. This is not a general-purpose AI handed a blueprint and told to figure it out. H1 was built from the ground up for this one job, and the results show it. Why General AI Gets Takeoffs Wrong Construction estimating is challenging. It is not a test of raw intelligence. It requires three things simultaneously: Reading drawings at multiple scales and understanding spatial relationships across sheets Connecting dimensions and specs that exist on different sheets, in different formats Knowing the unwritten conventions — the trade knowledge baked into how experienced estimators read plans Run most AI tools on the same set of residential plans three times, and you will get answers that vary by 50 to 70 percent and are often completely wrong. These models were not built for blueprints. They were built to be generalists. Estimating is not a generalist job. We decided to measure exactly how wide the gap was. The Benchmark: A 30-Point Gap To measure H1 against what is actually out there, we built TakeoffBench-V1: 10 residential blueprint sets, scored against expert-validated material quantities across every major trade. We ran eight leading AI models on the same plans. They clustered between 50 and 56 percent accuracy. The spread between the best and worst of those eight models is smaller than the gap between any one of them and H1. H1 scored 81.6% . For context: experienced human estimators with access to takeoff software scored around 77 to 78 percent on the same benchmark, and took up to a week to complete the work H1 finishes in approximately 2 hours. Construction estimating is one of the hardest technical problems in the built environment. It requires seeing blueprints the way a master estimator does, knowing the conventions that never get written down, and getting the quantities right across every trade. Handoff H1 is the first system that genuinely earns its results on this task. It is what purpose-built AI looks like when it meets a real domain problem head-on. — Dmitry Alexin, CEO & Founder, Handoff The TakeoffBench-V1 evaluation harness is publicly available through the OpenHarbor framework. Blueprint sets and ground truth quantities are available upon research request. What This Means for Contractors Who Bid Every Week Benchmark numbers are useful. But here is what actually matters to the contractor at his desk at 4:30 AM: H1 hands those hours back. A manual takeoff on a typical residential project can take an experienced estimator 8 to 20 hours. That time comes out of bidding capacity, project management, client relationships, and the sales work that actually grows a business, and often out of sleep and health. For contractors running lean operations and bidding multiple jobs per week, the compounding effect is brutal. More bids mean more takeoffs, and more takeoffs mean more nights and early mornings grinding through drawings. The risk on the other side is just as real. A single miscalculation can snowball into hundreds of thousands of dollars of overruns on a modest residential project. Materials come in wrong. The bid gets padded to cover the uncertainty. You either lose the job on price or take it and eat the variance. H1 reduces that risk. It reads the whole drawing set, not just one sheet, and produces a complete material quantity list that a contractor can review, trust, and build a proposal from. Nobody starts a construction business to do takeoffs. You start one to build real buildings. H1 gives those hours back. — Dmitry Alexin, CEO & Founder, Handoff How H1 Works There is no complex setup. No trade-specific configuration. No drawing convention training required from you. Upload your blueprint PDF to Handoff H1 reads the full drawing set — all sheets, all trades Specialized agents work through the drawings trade by trade, the way an experienced estimator would A complete material takeoff is ready for your review From there, the takeoff flows directly into your Handoff estimate and proposal — same system, same workflow, no re-entry. Available Now H1 is available today to all Scale Plan subscribers and Enterprise API customers . Enterprise teams can integrate H1 directly into existing estimation workflows via the Handoff API ( api@handoff.ai ). If you are on Handoff Scale, H1 is ready for your next set of plans. If you are not on Handoff yet , now is a good time to see what the platform can do.
